name: The Hardy Compound Chronicles
overview: An avant-garde saga of "Broken Brilliance" that transformed professional wrestling. This collection chronicles the supernatural warfare at Matt Hardy’s North Carolina estate, featuring the legendary Final Deletion, Delete or Decay, and Tag Team Apocalypto. Witness the battle between "Broken" Matt and Brother Nero as they utilize the Lake of Reincarnation, Vanguard 1, and fireworks to delete their rivals in a genre-defying blend of B-movie horror and high-stakes wrestling.
